node.title: Global exact-periodic source owner and dyadic profile charge
node.statement: For every cyclic RS row and received word, listed codewords whose full agreement set has exact stabilizer M>1 inject canonically into ceil((k+sigma)/M)-subsets of the quotient fibers. The owner is chart-free and disjoint across exact scales. On the official dyadic sigma=1 grid, all exact-periodic source codewords together fit one global 719(1+2^-690)Q_2(k+2) first-scale profile line. Algebraically folded codewords against nonfolded receivers and stabilizer-one low-defect closures are explicitly not claimed; the precise folded-receiver source class is proved downstream to be included here.
